name: Star Jewel
description: The Star Jewel was a starship manufactured by Ubrikkian Industries that was owned by the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Imperial Era. At some prior to or during 3 ABY, Jabba's majordomo Bib Fortuna was on board the vessel when it made a layover stop on the world of Nar Haaska, where the shipjacker Bandit Billie and her crew of Taurill attempted to steal the ship.
